verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a REST API for managing sites, deploys and DNS, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable or try-it examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file and the Markdown versions of docs pages are AI-friendly documentation, which is an adjacent feature, not an interactive runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
